title: Found a project
summary: The kit checks what you have and helps prepare the project and its records.

exits.0: Every tool the kit needs to found your pieces is ready.
exits.1: Something founding needs is not ready.
exits.2: The command line options are not valid.

person_decides: You answer the interview questions and decide whether to use existing work.

title: Shape a piece
summary: The kit turns a request into one clear task and records what must be decided before work begins.
person_decides: You settle questions that need your judgement, then decide whether to offer the ready piece to /implement.

title: Implement a piece
summary: The agent builds one ready task, checks the change and saves it for review.

exits.0: Nothing to say about the structure check.
exits.1: The change added a loop or crossed a boundary.
exits.2: The check could not run; note this internally.

person_decides: By default, you try the result and decide whether to merge the named pull request. Automatic merging is an opt-in recorded with limits.

title: Review the change
summary: A reviewer checks whether the saved change meets its goal and whether the evidence supports it.
person_decides: You decide whether a review finding is worth stopping for.

title: Merge the change
summary: The kit checks the approval and merges the change you named.

exits.1: A check, review box, review version or risk area holds the merge.

person_decides: By default, you give a yes that names the pull request to merge. Automatic merging is an opt-in recorded with limits.

title: Set up or check the live tool
summary: The kit sets up hosting or checks the live tool against the project.
person_decides: You decide whether to go live after hearing the warning about live changes.

title: Maintain the project
summary: The kit checks project records, compares the live tool with the project and handles due upkeep.

exits.0: The standing instructions file has fewer than 200 lines.
exits.1: The file has 200 lines or more; the monthly visit offers a trim.
exits.2: The file could not be read.

person_decides: You decide whether to apply changes beyond routine updates.
